units.source_text: 早晨中京的上空万里无云，可不知什么时候阴沉下来了，说不定北山下着雷阵雨。

en.t: In the morning the sky over Nakagyo was cloudless, but at some point it had turned overcast; perhaps there was a thunderstorm falling over the northern hills.

units.source_text: 从城里也可以看见这般天色。

en.t: Even from within the city, one could see that kind of sky.

units.source_text: 要不是京都优美的小山峦挡住，或许还能看到远方天阴得要下雪的样子呢。

en.t: If Kyoto's graceful little mountains had not blocked the view, one might even have seen the distant sky darkening as though snow were about to fall.
